name: Hikal Ltd
title: Hikal Ltd - 524735 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 margin recovered to 20.3% EBITDA and crop volumes improved, but FY26 revenue fell to INR1,713 cr, pharma lost Q4 shipments to a US FDA warning letter, and FY27 guidance was withheld.

utilisation.quote: pharma plants at Panoli and Bangalore operating at an average capacity utilization of nearly 80% to 85%

capex.quote: we have incurred capital expenditure of INR149 crores for debottlenecking, regulatory upgrades, and expanding CDMO capacities

triggers.label: Pharma utilisation ~80-85%
triggers.quote: operating at an average capacity utilization of nearly 80% to 85%

triggers.label: Crop pricing still under pressure
triggers.quote: pricing pressures still remain. China has not increased prices on the agrochemical side.

triggers.label: FY27 guidance withheld
triggers.quote: I don't want to give any forward-looking guidance in this quarter, I would be in a better position to do it after quarter 1 results.

triggers.label: Pharma Q4 shipments lost to FDA issue
triggers.quote: for the quarter 4, we have lost the business. But it will come back in the next few quarters

guidance.quote: we did give a guidance of growth in February, no doubt about it
FY '27, I don't want to give any guidance, as I mentioned.

guidance.value: INR6,000 cr plan still stands (delayed 2-3 years)
guidance.quote: we have FY '30 plan which still stands
we're still on track with the guidance that we gave you in September to build a INR500 crores plus business in the next 4 to 5 years
We are now targeting 5 to 6 DMF filings annually compared to 2 to 3 filings historically

prior_guidance_check.quote: while our revenues for Pharma division are down Y-o-Y
the crop business had its own structural issues from the industry perspective, which was more or less flattish compared to the previous year

red_flags.label: US FDA warning letter at Bangalore; Q4 pharma shipments lost
red_flags.quote: we have been advised by our GMP consultants to pressure test the system a little more and go slow for some production activities

red_flags.label: Exceptional items INR85 cr; PBT negative
red_flags.quote: PBT stood at negative INR79.3 crores, which is after providing INR85 crores as an exceptional item for the entire year

red_flags.label: Three years of flat-to-declining revenue
red_flags.quote: last 3 years have been flattish, if not some years have even degrown

evasions.quote: I don't want to give any guidance, as I mentioned. There's a lot of uncertainty.

evasions.topic: Pricing on Chinese inputs and FY27 margin
evasions.quote: we do expect FY '27 margins to sustain at improved levels
